info.title: API.SH: Otodom
info.description: The Otodom API from API.SH: public Otodom data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An Otodom estate agency or developer page: name, description, logo, address, phones, website, active, sale, rent and development listing counts, cities, on-Otodom-since date and badges, plus its listings (summary fields as in /otodom/v1/search). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/otodom-agency

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An otodom.pl/pl/firmy/biura-nieruchomosci/... (or /deweloperzy/...) link, or `id` with the slug ending in -ID<number>.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Otodom new-build developments and their units
get.description:
New-build developments in Poland on Otodom. Without `url`: a search of developments with the site's filters (location, price, area, price per m², build year, keywords, days since listed, radius, sort); each result has the summary fields of /otodom/v1/search plus construction state, estimated delivery (year and quarter), number of units, unit area range, unit rooms range and price from per m². With `url` (or `id`): one development with its description, state, start and finish dates, units in the project and listed, area and ceiling-height ranges, price from per m², floors, extra spaces, unit counts by rooms, location with coordinates, photos, video, the developer (name, page, logo, phones, address) and a page of its units: id, link, title, category, price, currency, price per m², area, plot area, rooms, floor, build year, finishing state, availability date, special offer, photos, floor plans and every characteristic, with the price, area and room facets. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/otodom-investments

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An otodom.pl/pl/inwestycja/... (or /pl/oferta/...) development link from the search results: returns that development and its units.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The development slug ending in -ID..., instead of `url`.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Search: location path as in otodom.pl search links (voivodeship/county/commune/city[/district]). Default: all of Poland.

parameters.name: days_since_created
parameters.description: Search: listed within this many days (1, 3, 7, 14, 30).

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Search: extra radius around the location (km).

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description: With `url`: only units with these room counts, comma-separated (1-10), e.g. 2,3.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order. Units (with `url`): price_asc (default), price_desc, area_asc, area_desc. Search: any of the values (default relevance).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Otodom listing: title, description, status, category, transaction, market, price, currency, price per m², rent, area, rooms, every characteristic (floor, building type and material, year, heating, condition, ownership...), features, dates, reference, location with coordinates, street, city, district, all photos, floor plans, video and 3D tour, development, the agency (name, page, logo, phones, address) and the agent; a private owner's phone is left out. Pass `latest=true` with search filters to open the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/otodom-listing

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An otodom.pl/pl/oferta/... link (or `id` with the slug ending in -ID...).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: open the first current result of a search made with the other filter params given here (the same as the search route's, e.g. location), instead of `id`/`url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Property in Poland on Otodom with the site's filters: sale or rent; flat, house, room, plot, commercial, warehouse, garage or new development; location; price, area, price per m², rooms, floors, build year, plot area, extras, building type, market, advertiser type, keywords, days since listed, radius and sort. Each result has id, link, title, price, currency, rent, price per m², area, rooms, floor, street, city, district and neighbourhood, dates, promoted and exclusive flags, advertiser type, agency (name, page, logo), development and photos. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/otodom-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Location path as in otodom.pl search links (voivodeship/county/commune/city[/district]), e.g. mazowieckie/warszawa/warszawa/warszawa or malopolskie/krakow/krakow/krakow. Default: all of Poland.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of the filters: an otodom.pl/pl/wyniki/... search link, used with all its filters.

parameters.name: floors
parameters.description: Floors, comma-separated: CELLAR, GROUND, FIRST ... TENTH, ABOVE_TENTH, GARRET.

parameters.name: plot_area_min
parameters.description: Minimum plot area (m², houses and plots).

parameters.name: extras
parameters.description: Extras, comma-separated: BALCONY, TERRACE, GARDEN, GARAGE, LIFT, BASEMENT, SEPARATE_KITCHEN, AIR_CONDITIONING, TWO_STOREY, USABLE_ROOM, ...

parameters.name: building_type
parameters.description: Building types, comma-separated: BLOCK, TENEMENT, HOUSE, INFILL, RIBBON, APARTMENT, LOFT.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Extra radius around the location in km (0, 5, 10, 15, 25, 50, 75).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The listings Otodom recommends next to a listing: id, title, link, sale or rent, category, price, currency, price per m², area, rooms, every characteristic, street, location, coordinates and photos.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/otodom-similar

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The numeric listing id. id or url is required.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An otodom.pl/pl/oferta/<slug>-ID... link, instead of id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
